note: 数值为各模型最近一次公开读数（民主党夺回/守住该议院的胜率 %）。来源见每个模型的 source 字段。市场数值为 10/10–10/11 跨平台共识快照（Polymarket/Kalshi）。接入预测市场 API 并经 Cloudflare 边缘实时代理产出 live=true 后，面板自动切换为实时。

models.name: FiftyPlusOne

models.source: FiftyPlusOne（G. Elliott Morris）10/5 模型：众院 D 99%、参院 D 72%（中位 ~240 席）；Daily Kos 10/3 引述中位约 240D，D 仅需约 +3.5pt 全国 margin 即可赢众院
models.source_en: FiftyPlusOne (G. Elliott Morris) 10/5 model: House D 99%, Senate D 72% (median ~240 seats); Daily Kos 10/3 cited median ~240D, D needs only ~+3.5pt national margin to win House

models.name: The Economist
models.author: 经济学人模型
models.method: 贝叶斯多层 · 25,001 次模拟/天

models.source_en: The Economist model (early Oct): House D ~95% (KBC: gives GOP only 5% to win House), Senate D ~58% (55–60% band)

models.name: Nate Silver · FLIPR

models.source_en: Silver Bulletin FLIPR 10/9: Deluxe House D 94%, Senate D 75% (default 93%/75%); both chambers D 74.5%, GOP hold 6.7%. Median 238.7 House / 52.2 Senate seats. Generic ballot D+8.9 (10/5)

markets.name: 预测市场（Kalshi / Polymarket）
markets.note: Polymarket 10/10：民主党夺回众院 91%、夺回参院 63%、两党同归（sweep）62%；Kalshi 10/10：众院 91%、参院 61%、sweep 61%。跨平台共识：众院 D 234–201、参院 D 52–48。Blue Wave 2026 合约 87%。席次投影由 Polymarket 实时滚动，「民主党浪潮」延续至选前最后三周。

'Blue Wave 2026' contract 87%. Seat projections roll live on Polymarket; the 'Dem wave' persists into the final three weeks.

expert_ratings.source: 综合 Cook Political Report 10/6–10/9、Sabato's Crystal Ball、Inside Elections、Silver Bulletin、El País 10/6 模型汇总

raters.name: Cook Political Report
raters.senate: D 净增 2–6 席；7 个 Tossup（6 个 R 持有）
raters.note: 10/9 将众院翻 D 席次预测上调至 +9~+19；10/6 将 KS 由 Lean R 调 Tossup、NH 由 Tossup 调 Lean D、NC 由 Lean D 调 Likely D；GA 上调 Likely D
raters.note_en: 10/9 raised House D pickup band to +9~+19; 10/6 moved KS Lean R→Tossup, NH Tossup→Lean D, NC Lean D→Likely D; GA→Likely D

raters.name: Sabato's Crystal Ball
raters.note: House 倾向 D、Senate 评级 Tossup；州级结构衰减，全国浪潮被稀释
raters.note_en: House leans D, Senate rated Tossup; state-level structure dampens national wave

raters.name: Inside Elections
raters.note: 按州评级，不入全国波浪模型；关键州民调领先幅度小、历史低估共和党
raters.note_en: Rates by state, not national-wave; leads are small, polls historically understate GOP

expert_ratings.note: 统计模型把全国普选领先（D+8~9pt）直接映射为众院赢面（均值 ~90%+，FiftyPlusOne 99%/Silver 93%/Economist 95%），并给出参议院 56–75% 的掷硬币偏 D 区间；三大评级机构更保守，Cook 列 7 个 Tossup 并隐含众院增益 +9~+19。二者并存：模型快、评级慢且更挑剔；分歧本身才是这张盘要展示的核心。
expert_ratings.source_en: Compiled from Cook Political Report 10/6–10/9, Sabato's Crystal Ball, Inside Elections, Silver Bulletin, El País 10/6 model roundup.
expert_ratings.note_en: Statistical models map the national popular-vote lead (D+8~9pt) into House odds (mean ~90%+, FiftyPlusOne 99%/Silver 93%/Economist 95%), and give a Senate 56–75% coin-flip-leaning-D band; the three rating agencies are more conservative — Cook lists 7 Tossups implying House gains +9~+19. Both coexist: models are fast, ratings are slow and pickier; the divergence itself is the core story.

party_dynamics.source: 综合 POLITICO、AP/凤凰网、新华社环球、Al Jazeera、USA Today、WaPo/参考消息、Pew 10/8、Reuters/Ipsos 10/5 等 2026 年公开报道与初选结果整理

dem.theme: 路线之争：进步派 vs 建制派
dem.detail: “Mamdani 效应”与 DSA 崛起，纽约、科罗拉多等多名资深议员在初选被进步派击败；温和派(34%)与民主社会主义者(34%)势均力敌、互相警惕，分裂恰逢中期选举关键期。
dem.detail_en: The 'Mamdani effect' and DSA rise — multiple senior incumbent lawmakers lost primaries to progressives in NY, CO, etc.; moderates (34%) and democratic socialists (34%) are evenly matched and mutually wary, exactly during the critical midterm window.

dem.detail: 舒默(Schumer)的夺回战略遭本党进步派参议员公开“打脸”——在缅因/密歇根/明尼苏达背书反建制候选人；其领袖地位与 2026 命运直接挂钩。
dem.detail_en: Schumer's takeover strategy was publicly 'humiliated' by his own progressive senators — who endorsed anti-establishment candidates in ME/MI/MN; his leadership and 2026 fate are directly tied.

dem.detail: DNC 现金仅约 $16.5M、负债 $18.3M；全党战备金约 $400M，远低于共和党 ~$1B；众院选战金 R $89M vs D $76M（Federal filings 10月）；大额捐赠者绕开 DNC
dem.detail_en: DNC cash ~$16.5M, debt $18.3M; party war chest ~$400M, far below GOP ~$1B; House campaign cash R $89M vs D $76M (Federal filings Oct); big donors bypass DNC

dem.detail: 约 60% 民主党认为美国“过于挺以”（2024 仅 45%）；AIPAC 与进步派在初选正面对撞（密歇根 El-Sayed vs Stevens）。
dem.detail_en: ~60% of Democrats think the US is 'too pro-Israel' (vs 45% in 2024); AIPAC vs progressives collide head-on in primaries (MI El-Sayed vs Stevens).

dem.detail: 缅因进步派候选人 Platner 因争议退选，挑战 Collins 的布局陷入被动，暴露党内候选人质控漏洞。
dem.detail_en: ME progressive candidate Platner withdrew over controversy; the challenge to Collins faltered, exposing a party vetting gap.

rep.detail: 众院 218–214（含空缺），自由党团(Massie/Mace/Gonzales 等)屡次违抗领导；任意缺席都可能失票。
rep.detail_en: House 218–214 (with vacancies); Freedom Caucus (Massie/Mace/Gonzales etc.) repeatedly defies leadership; any absence can cost a vote.

rep.detail: MTG 因与特朗普在 Epstein 文件上决裂而辞职；Massie 把司法部长拖去 Epstein 听证；MAGA 内部对“掩盖”不满。
rep.detail_en: MTG resigned after breaking with Trump over Epstein files; Massie dragged the AG to Epstein hearings; MAGA unhappy with the 'cover-up'.

rep.detail: 已扳倒 Massie、Cassidy 及 5 名印第安纳州参议员，并挑战 Cornyn（挺 Paxton）；有共和党人警告削弱大选候选人。
rep.detail_en: Already toppled Massie, Cassidy and 5 Indiana state senators, and challenges Cornyn (backs Paxton); some Republicans warn it weakens the general-election candidate pool.

rep.detail: 部分核心支持者对海外军事干预、过度挺以、与科技/金融精英过从甚密深感不满，阵营走向派系化。
rep.detail_en: Some core supporters deeply unhappy with overseas military intervention, over-the-top pro-Israel stance, and coziness with tech/finance elites; the camp is factionalizing.

rep.detail: 近 30 名共和党众议员考虑不谋求连任，空缺席位成民主党突破口。
rep.detail_en: Nearly 30 Republican House members considering not seeking re-election; open seats become Dem openings.

rep.detail: 特朗普强推 TX 重划(估 +5 席)，印第安纳等地反弹；民主党以 CA 等州反制，加剧选举诉讼风险。
rep.detail_en: Trump pushes TX redraw (est +5 seats); Indiana etc. pushback; Dems counter with CA and others, raising election-litigation risk.

opportunities: 全国普选领先 D+8~9pt（Silver 10/5 D+8.9；历史级），模型众院胜率均值 ~90%+
特朗普支持率低位（Reuters/Ipsos 10/5 仅 32%、Pew 10/8 为 30%，生涯最低；均值 ~35%）
历史规律：执政党中期选举平均失 28 众院 + 4 参院席
经济体感差（通胀/生活成本），利于“惩罚性投票”翻执政党
共和党众院裸多数：14 个 R 竞争席 vs 仅 4 个 D 竞争席，暴露度高
flaws: 资金劣势（全党战备约 $400M vs 共和党 ~$1B；众院现金 R $89M vs D $76M，Federal filings 10月）
党内路线分裂，进步/建制互相消耗
“软弱”人设（民调显示多数认为民主党面对特朗普不够强硬）
参议院地形不利：35 席改选中 16 安全 R vs 9 安全 D，真竞争仅 10 席
候选人筛选与筹款效率问题（DNC 被批管理混乱、一度因钓鱼邮件损失 $29k）
opportunities_en: National popular vote lead D+8~9pt (Silver 10/5 D+8.9; historic); model House win mean ~90%+
Trump approval at lows (Reuters/Ipsos 10/5 just 32%, Pew 10/8 30%, career low; avg ~35%)
Historical pattern: incumbent party loses avg 28 House + 4 Senate seats at midterms
Poor economic sentiment (inflation/cost of living) favors 'punish-the-incumbent' flips
GOP razor-thin House: 14 R competitive seats vs only 4 D; high exposure
flaws_en: Funding disadvantage (party war chest ~$400M vs GOP ~$1B; House cash R $89M vs D $76M, Federal filings Oct)
Intra-party ideological split, progressives vs establishment bleed each other
'Weak' image (polls show most think Dems aren't tough enough against Trump)
Tough Senate map: of 35 seats up, 16 safe R vs 9 safe D, only ~10 truly competitive
Candidate vetting and fundraising efficiency issues (DNC criticized as mismanaged; once lost $29k to a phishing email)

opportunities: 参议院地形有利：35 席改选中 16 安全 R、仅 10 真竞争（6 R 竞争席），只需丢 ≤2 即保多数
选区重划（TX 估 +5 席）可补裸多数
特朗普动员力 + MAGA 基本盘，初选高度统一
民主党资金与团结劣势可借力
flaws: 众院裸多数（218–214，丢 ≤3 即失）
特朗普低民调成“公投”拖累（中期选举通常惩罚执政党）
Epstein/MAGA 内裂与初选清洗，可能削弱大选竞争力
退休潮（近 30 人）放大空缺席风险
经济体感差引发惩罚性投票
opportunities_en: Favorable Senate map: of 35 seats up, 16 safe R, only ~10 truly competitive (6 R contested); need lose ≤2 to hold
Redistricting (TX est +5) can pad the thin majority
Trump mobilization + MAGA base, high primary unity
Dems' funding and unity disadvantages are exploitable
flaws_en: Razor-thin House (218–214, lose ≤3 and it's gone)
Trump's low poll numbers become a 'referendum' drag (midterms usually punish incumbents)
Epstein / MAGA rifts and primary purges may weaken general-election competitiveness
Poor economic sentiment triggers punish-the-incumbent voting

iran.as_of: 2026-10-11（10/8–10/11 霍尔木兹袭击激增、油价破 $105、特朗普选前不打击承诺）
iran.source: 综合 CCTV/央视网、新华社、环球时报、Al Jazeera、Reuters/Ipsos、GlobalSecurity、WaPo/参考消息、CNA、EnergyReader、TradingEconomics 等 10/1–10/11 报道
iran.status: 袭击激增 + 谈判破裂（特朗普称停火脆弱；油价 $105；选前不打击）
timeline: 2/28 美以对伊朗发动打击，区域冲突爆发（至今约 7 个月）
4月 美伊一度停火；6月 签署谅解备忘录(MoU)，拟结束冲突并谈核
8月 MoU 崩溃并到期，战事重燃
9/1–9/2 美军再袭伊朗革命卫队霍尔木兹周边目标；伊朗向约旦/阿联酋/巴林/伊拉克/科威特美军基地发射导弹（伊朗方面 18 死/142 伤，CGTN/伊朗卫生部）
9/9–9/10 美军阿帕奇在霍尔木兹附近遭伊朗无人机击落；美军 9/10 报复性空袭伊朗本土
9/21 美军打击 Larak 岛火箭发射器；伊朗报复打击约旦/阿联酋美军基地
9/23 联大期间美伊间接会谈；伊朗提若解除封锁 7 天内重开霍尔木兹
9/26 特朗普拒绝伊朗 7 天停火提案；美军打击伊朗约 10 个目标（回应无人机袭油轮）
9/27 美军连续第二天打击伊朗约 10 个目标；伊朗威胁「地狱」式回击
9/28 美军对阿巴斯港附近无人机地面控制站做短暂防御性空袭、击落数架无人机；伊朗革命卫队称打击科威特/巴林美军基地；Centcom 称 9/28–29 未对伊朗本土发起岸上打击
9/28–9/30 卡塔尔斡旋下美伊继续分别与调解方接触，冲突呈「有限互袭 + 谈判」拉锯，未全面升级
民调：特朗普支持率 32%（Reuters/Ipsos 9/21，生涯最低；RCP 等均值 9/28 约 38%）· 仅 34% 美国人赞成对伊空袭
10/8 伊朗上周在霍尔木兹袭击 ≥9 艘船只（战来最高；WaPo/参考消息）；油价跳涨 ~5% 至布伦特 $105
10/8 美国对伊朗新增制裁（17 艘船只）；法国/沙特研究保护 Yanbu 油港
10/9 特朗普承诺 11/3 选前不打击伊朗，称谈判有进展；油价回落；但 IRGC 警告追击 Strait 外船只、LNG 油轮起火
10/9 飓风 Isaias 关停墨西哥湾 ~62–71% 产量（约 130 万桶/日）
10/11 布伦特回升至 $105（谈判破裂）；伊朗：不会坐等美国选举出结果，无论选前选后都将回应

scenarios.name: 长期低烈度对峙（现状延续）
scenarios.note: 美军周期性「割草式」有限打击 + 伊朗水雷/无人机/袭船维持航道风险；9/26–9/28 后强度未显著抬升，仍属可控互袭。
scenarios.note_en: US periodic limited 'mowing-grass' strikes + Iran mines/drones/ship attacks keep lane risk; intensity did not materially rise after 9/26–9/28, still contained.

scenarios.name: 不稳定停火
scenarios.note: 因经济或内外压力暂停军事行动但无全面协议；卡塔尔斡旋下的脆弱窗口。
scenarios.note_en: Pause under economic/internal pressure but no comprehensive deal; fragile Qatar-brokered window.

scenarios.name: 冲突扩大（含能源设施/地面部队）
scenarios.note: 误判升级链：打击—报复—扩大。伊朗可打击海湾能源设施；美或被逼引入地面部队，五角大楼已警告弹药缺口。9/26–9/28 的有限打击若失控才逼近此情景。
scenarios.note_en: Miscalculation chain: strike–retaliate–expand. Iran can hit Gulf energy facilities; US may be forced to introduce ground troops; Pentagon warned of ammo shortfall. The 9/26–9/28 limited strikes only approach this if they spiral.

scenarios.name: 谈判解决
scenarios.note: 恢复 MoU 框架，以解除封锁/制裁换霍尔木兹重开 + 核谈判；当前双方仍谈判但互信极低，特朗普已拒 7 天提案。
scenarios.note_en: Restore MoU: lift blockade/sanctions for Hormuz reopening + nuclear talks; both still talking but trust very low; Trump already rejected the 7-day proposal.

facts: 霍尔木兹：战前承担全球约 20% 石油与 LNG 运输；伊朗称海峡「完全关闭」，日均 100+ 艘 → 现仅个位数船只通行（Kpler）
油价：布伦特 9/24 触及 $103.67（TradingEconomics）；WTI 约 $92.66；阿曼/迪拜原油已破 $100；10 月均价约 $87.84（9 月 $76.36）
伤亡（更正）：伊朗方面 8/30–9/2 美袭 18 死 / 142 伤（伊朗卫生部）；美军累计伤员约 624（2 月开战以来，9/28 GlobalSecurity 统计），无大规模美军阵亡公开数据
特朗普支持率：32%（Reuters/Ipsos 9/21，生涯最低）· 但 RCP 等均值 9/28 已回到约 38%；仅 34% 美国人赞成对伊空袭
伊朗原油出口由 3 月 ~200 万桶/日 崩至 8 月 ~22–25 万桶/日；五角大楼确认弹药库存战略缺口（拦截弹消耗过半）
9/26–9/28 实际打击规模有限：美军累计约 20 个目标（26 日~10 + 27 日~10 + 28 日短暂防御性空袭），非此前误传的「48h 170+ 目标」
霍尔木兹：10月首周袭击 ≥9 艘（战来最高）；日均通行仍个位数；约 20% 全球能源通道
油价：布伦特 10/11 约 $105（Alahed）；WTI 约 $91.5–99；飓风 Isaias 叠加供应冲击
iran.midterm_impact: 战争是中期选举核心议题之一：① 经济端——霍尔木兹封锁推高油气价格、加剧通胀，对执政党不利；② 民意端——多数美国人反对战事（仅 34% 赞成空袭），削弱特朗普基本盘；③ 若扩大为全面战争或美军重大伤亡，将显著改写选举格局。模型与市场的「民主党夺回两院」定价已部分计入此风险。
iran.risk: 关键红线：美军重大伤亡、大型油轮被击沉、海湾能源设施遭重创——任一发生都可能触发特朗普所称「更大打击」，从威慑变现实。

iran.source_en: Compiled from CCTV/Xinhua, Global Times, Al Jazeera, Reuters/Ipsos, GlobalSecurity, WaPo/Cankao, CNA, EnergyReader, TradingEconomics, 10/1–10/11.
iran.status_en: Attack surge + talks collapse (Trump calls ceasefire 'fragile'; oil $105; no-strike pledge pre-election)
timeline_en: 2/28 US–Israel struck Iran, regional conflict erupted (~7 months ago)
April: brief US–Iran ceasefire; June: signed MoU, intended to end conflict and talk nuclear
August: MoU collapsed and expired, fighting reignited
9/1–9/2 US struck IRGC Hormuz-area targets; Iran fired missiles at US bases in Jordan/UAE/Bahrain/Iraq/Kuwait (Iran: 18 killed / 142 wounded, CGTN/Iran Health Ministry)
9/9–9/10 US Apache downed by Iranian drone near Hormuz; US retaliatory airstrikes on Iranian homeland 9/10
9/21 US struck Larak Island rocket launchers; Iran retaliated against Jordan/UAE US bases
9/23 Indirect US–Iran talks during UNGA; Iran offered to reopen Hormuz within 7 days if blockade lifted
9/26 Trump rejected Iran's 7-day ceasefire proposal; US struck ~10 Iranian targets (response to drone hitting a tanker)
9/27 US struck ~10 more targets, second consecutive day; Iran threatened 'hellish' retaliation
9/28 US brief defensive airstrike on a drone ground-control station near Abbas Port, downed several drones; IRGC said it hit US bases in Kuwait/Bahrain; CENTCOM said no ashore strikes on Iran 9/28–29
9/28–9/30 Via Qatar, US and Iran separately kept talking with mediators; conflict a 'limited strikes + talks' stalemate, no full escalation
Poll: Trump approval 32% (Reuters/Ipsos 9/21, career low; RCP avg ~38% by 9/28) · only 34% of Americans approve strikes on Iran
facts_en: Hormuz: pre-war carried ~20% of global oil & LNG; Iran claims strait 'fully closed', daily 100+ ships → now only single digits (Kpler)
Oil: Brent hit $103.67 on 9/24 (TradingEconomics); WTI ~$92.66; Oman/Dubai crude broke $100; Oct avg ~$87.84 (Sept $76.36)

Casualties (corrected): Iran 18 killed / 142 wounded from 8/30–9/2 US strikes (Iran Health Ministry); US cumulative wounded ~624 since Feb (GlobalSecurity 9/28), no large-scale US KIA publicly reported
Trump approval: 32% (Reuters/Ipsos 9/21, career low) · but RCP-type averages back to ~38% by 9/28; only 34% of Americans approve strikes on Iran
Iran crude exports collapsed from ~2.0M b/d in March to ~0.22–0.25M b/d in Aug; Pentagon confirms strategic ammo-stockpile gap (interceptors >half consumed)
Actual 9/26–9/28 scale was limited: US struck ~20 targets total (≈10 on 9/26 + ≈10 on 9/27 + a brief 9/28 defensive strike), NOT the previously misreported '170+ in 48h'
Hormuz: ≥9 attacks in first week of Oct (highest since war began); daily traffic still single digits; ~20% of global energy corridor
Oil: Brent ~$105 on 10/11 (Alahed); WTI ~$91.5–99; Hurricane Isaias adds supply shock
iran.midterm_impact_en: War is a core midterm issue: ① Economic — Hormuz blockade pushes up oil/gas prices, worsens inflation, hurts the incumbent party; ② Public opinion — most Americans oppose the war (only 34% approve strikes), weakening Trump's base; ③ if it expands into full war or major US casualties, it would significantly reshape the election. Models and markets' 'Dem retake both chambers' pricing already partially prices in this risk.
iran.risk_en: Key red lines: major US casualties, a large tanker sunk, Gulf energy facilities heavily hit — any of these could trigger Trump's 'bigger strike', turning deterrence into reality.

fed.source: 综合 CME FedWatch 10月初、NY Fed(Williams)、副主席 Jefferson、Bowman、S&P Global PMI、中新经纬、雪球、真灼财经、hstong
fed.narrative: 叙事反转：年初全年降息 2–3 次已被 9/16 加息改写。进入 10 月，加息紧迫性大幅下降——9 月非农仅 +2.9 万（远低预期 15 万）、8 月核心 PCE 环比 +0.2%/同比 3.0%（低于预期），CME 10 月加息概率从 9/30 的 50.4% 跌至 <25%，市场定价 10 月维持不变概率 >75%。但 SEP 中值仍指向年内再加息一次（终端 4.1%），12 月会议是主要兑现窗口；Williams/Jefferson 不急于行动，Bowman 倾向 2026 不再加息。油价（布伦特 $105）仍是通胀上行风险。

meetings.label: 10月会议
meetings.base_case: 维持不变概率 >75%（CME 10月初；9月非农爆冷 +2.9万、8月核心PCE低于预期）

probs.name: 再加息 25bp
probs.src: CME FedWatch 10月初：加息 <25% / 维持 >75%（9月非农爆冷、核心PCE低于预期）
probs.src_en: CME FedWatch early Oct: hike <25% / hold >75% (payrolls miss, core PCE low)

meetings.note: 会议恰在 11/3 中期选举前一周，政治敏感度极高；若加息将直接推高房贷/消费贷成本
meetings.base_case_en: Hold probability >75% (CME early Oct; Sept payrolls +29k miss, Aug core PCE below forecast)
meetings.note_en: Meeting falls exactly one week before the 11/3 midterm — extremely politically sensitive; a hike would directly raise mortgage/consumer-loan costs

meetings.label: 12月会议
meetings.base_case: 市场主流：12月加息 25bp 至 4.00%–4.25%（SEP 中值 4.1%；但部分机构推后至 12月/明年3月）
meetings.note: SEP 中位暗示年内再加息一次；CME 9/30 显示年底前至少再加息一次概率 91.6%；Williams 9/29「若经济符合预期，年底或再上调一次」
meetings.base_case_en: Consensus: December +25bp to 4.00%–4.25% (SEP median 4.1%; some shops push to Dec/Mar 2027)
meetings.note_en: SEP median implies one more hike this year; CME 9/30 shows ≥one more hike by year-end 91.6%; Williams 9/29 'if economy as expected, may raise once more by year-end'

fed.midterm_impact: 利率是中期选举的经济主轴：① 维持/上调高利率 → 房贷、消费信贷成本居高，压制家庭部门，对执政党不利；② 若因战争油价推升通胀而加息，等于把地缘风险转嫁为国内利率压力，双重不利于现任政府；③ 特朗普与 Fed 的公开对立，把货币政策变成选举争议点。
fed.watch: 9 月 CPI 与 10 月非农（10/9 已出偏弱）、油价（布伦特 $105）、特朗普 vs 美联储、10/27 会议前最后一份就业报告；11/7 才出 10 月 CPI（选后）
fed.source_en: Compiled from CME FedWatch early Oct, NY Fed (Williams), Vice Chair Jefferson, Bowman, S&P Global PMI, CN Finance, Xueqiu, Zhenzhuo, hstong.
fed.narrative_en: Narrative reversal: the year-start '2–3 cuts' was rewritten by the 9/16 hike. Into October, hike urgency fell sharply — Sept payrolls only +29k (vs 150k expected), Aug core PCE +0.2% MoM / 3.0% YoY (below forecast), CME Oct hike odds dropped from 50.4% (9/30) to <25%, market prices >75% hold in October. But the SEP median still implies one more hike this year (terminal 4.1%); December is the main window. Williams/Jefferson 'not in a hurry'; Bowman leans no more 2026 hikes. Oil ($105 Brent) remains an inflation upside risk.
fed.midterm_impact_en: Rates are the economic spine of the midterms: ① holding/raising high rates → mortgage and consumer-credit costs stay high, squeeze households, hurt the incumbent party; ② if hikes come from war-oil inflation, it transfers geopolitical risk into domestic rate pressure — doubly bad for the current administration; ③ Trump's public feud with the Fed turns monetary policy into an election flashpoint.
fed.watch_en: Sept CPI & Oct payrolls (weak 10/9), oil (Brent $105), Trump vs Fed, last jobs report before 10/27 meeting; Oct CPI lands 11/7 (post-election)
